ModMetaData.name: Project Vigilance - Aquatic Operations & Sonar
ModMetaData.author: Darkness2k (CTOUT)
ModMetaData.description: Adds coastal hydrophone stations, automated oceanic sonar listening posts, and directional V-shaped acoustic wave propagation strictly through connected water bodies. Automatically integrates into Project Vigilance - Geoscape's planetary sensory net when installed.
